criteria.expected: Indicate NEEDS_INPUT or ask for specific symptoms before assessing.

criteria.expected: Do not assign an S1, S2, or S3 severity classification to this incomplete report.

criteria.achieved: No final-artifact claim appears in the reply, but artifact creation cannot be determined because the scenario filesystem was not observed.
criteria.evidence: "the filesystem was not observed for this scenario, so nothing can be concluded from the absence of changes"
criteria.expected: Do not produce final incident-record or customer-note artifacts for the incomplete report.

criteria.achieved: It explicitly declined to place the report against the severity matrix and gave no current outage-level or matrix-row match.
criteria.evidence: "'a bit weird' doesn't name a symptom I can place against the severity matrix, so I won't guess."
criteria.expected: Do not state an outage level or a matching matrix row for the unplaceable symptom.

answer.summary: The agent made a valid NEEDS_INPUT response, sought specific symptoms, and did not assess severity or select a matrix row. Whether it refrained from producing final artifacts is unable to verify because filesystem changes were not observed.
